Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Sunset Recreational Club offers a variety of low to moderate-risk recreational activities, including fitness classes such as yoga and Pilates, swimming pool use, and community events. The facility prioritizes safety with trained staff, regular equipment maintenance, and implemented safety protocols. We provide services in a controlled access environment, ensuring patron security. There is no on-site alcohol or food service, minimizing liquor liability exposures. Our commitment to a safe and enjoyable experience for all members and guests is fundamental to our operations.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2022, a non-member slipped on a wet pool deck due to a maintenance delay, resulting in a shoulder injury. The claim was settled for $5,000. The status is closed. On 07/20/2021, during a yoga class, a participant suffered a sprained ankle from improper footwear. The claim was settled for $3,000. The status is closed. On 01/10/2020, a member reported minor injuries from a faulty exercise machine (covered under equipment maintenance). The claim was settled for $2,000. The status is closed.
Application Data.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM, Saturday 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Sunday Closed
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class 1, Grade A, UL Listed Safe
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Controlled access security with perimeter fencing, trained watchpersons on-site during operational hours, and regular safety patrols throughout the facility.
